{{Top|leg}}
'''Procopian Transportation Ministry''' was a public service organization on the planet [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizer [[Teva Karne]] was a mid-level employee of the ministry during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="LOTE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
